title: AI-Driven Wireless Audio Conference System for Smartphone
summary: MUST pilots a smartphone audio system with automated speaking queues and transcription. Lower equipment costs and smoother participation are expected.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MUST pilots a smartphone audio system with automated speaking queues and transcription. Lower equipment costs and smoother participation are expected. Pilot environments described.
purpose: Make meetings easier to organize and participate in through existing smartphones.

ratings.reason: Pilots are described, but smoother participation and transcription benefits are presented as expected impacts.
Lower equipment and staffing costs are expected; the chapter supplies no observed saving.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 14: AI-Driven Wireless Audio Conference System for Smartphone

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Participating phones and the server on the same local Wi-Fi network
Compatibility with the venue public-address system

headline: Smartphones become AI-managed meeting microphones

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.
